verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a speech-to-text API that offers synchronous, live, and batch transcription. It is not an agent or assistant that invokes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The truncated 'MCP' heading in Zoom's llms.txt probe does not show Scribe consuming MCP servers, so it does not make this client-side axis applicable.
